definitions: A person from the northern states who went to the South after the Civil War to profit from the unsettled conditions.
A political candidate who seeks election in an area where they have no local connections.
A person who tries to gain control of a company or organization without having any previous involvement or legitimate interest.
examples: The locals viewed him as a carpetbagger.
He was accused of being a carpetbagger in the election.
The company fought off the carpetbagger's takeover attempt.
